description.en: Analyze commits, contributors, churn, and activity trends
description.de: Commits, Contributors, Churn und Aktivitäts-Trends analysieren

instructions.de: Erstelle einen Git-Statistik-Report. Variablen: project_path, since (z.B. '3 months ago').
instructions.en: Create a Git statistics report. Variables: project_path, since (e.g. '3 months ago').

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
SINCE="{{ since }}"
echo "=== Commit Summary (since $SINCE) ==="
TOTAL=$(git rev-list --count --since="$SINCE" HEAD)
AUTHORS=$(git log --since="$SINCE" --format='%aN' | sort -u | wc -l)
FIRST=$(git log --since="$SINCE" --reverse --format='%ad' --date=short | head -1)
LAST=$(git log --since="$SINCE" --format='%ad' --date=short | head -1)
echo "Total commits: $TOTAL"
echo "Unique authors: $AUTHORS"
echo "Period: $FIRST .. $LAST"
echo ""
echo "=== Top Authors ==="
git shortlog --since="$SINCE" -sn HEAD | head -10

set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
SINCE="{{ since }}"
echo "=== Most Changed Files (Top 20) ==="
git log --since="$SINCE" --format='' --name-only | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20

set -euo pipefail
cd "{{ project_path }}"
SINCE="{{ since }}"
echo "=== Activity by Weekday ==="
git log --since="$SINCE" --format="%ad" --date=format:"%A" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
echo ""
echo "=== Activity by Hour ==="
git log --since="$SINCE" --format="%ad" --date=format:"%H" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
